candidates.title: Metro extension will not open before 2030
candidates.search_snippet: The metro extension to the hospital will not enter service before the end of 2030 at best, the regional transport department said on Tuesday.
candidates.source_content: The metro extension to the hospital will not enter service before the end of 2030 at best, the regional transport department said on Tuesday. Construction continues, and the new target date depends on no further unforeseen problems arising on one of the city's most complex works.
